MARS HARNESS LAB - VERSION 5.2 OPERATIONAL METHODS UPDATE

Start with Mars_Harness_Operational_Methods_V5_2.zip for ten actionable methods, ten bounded specialist role contracts, ten JSON templates, eight dependency-free local checking commands, synthetic tests, and capability coverage. All eleven individual skill ZIPs and all eleven individual agent ZIPs include the shared methods; complete suites and the three-domain setup pack include them as well. Existing download URLs are retained.

The complete harness methods release contains the skills, agents, setup guides, wiki starter, and supporting text. Presentation, PDF, and artwork files remain separate. Explanations of the V5.2 features appear throughout the website: in the harness foundations, cross-domain chain, each application workflow, specialist roles, skills, and download notes—not only in the differentiator section. The presentation catalog identifies the current example deck; its source and derived slide assets must all match the designated version.

Readiness: procedures and local helpers are supplied. Real CAD/EDA, solvers, live twin telemetry, authenticated SaaS handoffs, GraphRAG services, and runtime permission enforcement require project-specific implementation and tests. Passing a local record check is not certification or approval.

Checksums in SHA256SUMS.txt use paths relative to the published site root. Inside each ZIP, PACKAGE_CONTENTS.json and SHA256SUMS.txt cover that package's payload. No credentials are included.

Start with the designated example presentation. Use the three-harness setup instructions to configure the Science, Engineering, and Project Management harnesses from the downloadable skills and agents. Use the architecture guide for implementation, the transcript for delivery, the MOXIE package for the worked example, the recursive specialist model for domain execution, and the portable-skills guide for runtime adaptation. The new methods extend option analysis, graph memory, chapter assembly, paired artifacts, simulation/review, handoff control, reproducibility, specialist routing, and measurement. Individual and complete skill ZIPs are included. Verify downloads with SHA256SUMS.txt.
